notes.title: Where is the meaning? Where is the meaning? VK PLAY released
notes.notes: We do not know when the game will be released on steam, since we do not have a Kazakhstani or any other bank account to link it to the store, and therefore we released the game vk play, if you follow the link below it will redirect you to our store page, where you can purchase the game and start playing it today. We remind you that we recorded about 2 thousand sounds for the game, each monster has its own unique dialogue, there are different ways to complete it and additional quests. The average time to complete the game took the developer 6 hours, you can also try to beat the game without a single battle, but you need to know all the intricacies of the game, I can only suggest that to overcome it in pacifist mode, try to collect all the unique items with you and not part with them until the end games. https://vkplay.ru/play/game/whereisthemeaning/
